items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I played around there with Johnny St. Sarah too. Johnny St. Sarah played with me an old Lego band one time.

ctx.x: You worked with Johnny St. Sarah then later too, didn't you, for a while?

I worked around, well, I worked, yeah, I worked around, on Decatur Street, they had a lot of joints on Decatur Street, before Budapest Street got popped in. I played around there with a lot of three and four-piece bands. I played around there with Johnny St. Sarah too. Johnny St. Sarah played with me an old Lego band one time.
When did you join Bill Matthews? How long has that been now?
